profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: I am an Embedded Software Engineer currently working at Meta on AR products

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Established build infrastructure for new AOSP-based product, including configuration management and device tree implementation
- Developed and integrated firmware for proprietary ASIC running on uC/OS-II RTOS platform
- Implemented power savings to meet ErP regulatory standards for a new product
- Modified QCOM MIPI DSI display drivers while updating reduced refresh rate drivers
- Designed and implemented a custom Linux USB driver for interfacing with proprietary USB hardware, including low-level packet analysis and debugging
- Coordinated memory validation testing with third-party laboratory
- Provided support for memory component selection
- Designed and implemented UART over SBU line console debugging access which involved XBL/ABL modifications
- Worked oncall rotation to help debug customer hardware issues
positions.insights: C (Programming Language), Kernel Drivers and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Developed low level, high performance software for RTOS (Nucleus OS)
- Managed upgrades to legacy systems and formal qualification testing
- Debugged multi-threaded real time applications running on embedded hardware
- Developed and maintained a .NET WPF application to test the integrity of proprietary systems
- Wrote automated tests in Python using proprietary testing frameworks
- Acquired a secret level security clearance

projects.title: OpenGL-SFML
projects.description: An OpenGL demo using SFML as the graphics context and for basic image/shader loading. This demo uses the Physically Based Rendering roughness/metallic workflow to render models and textures. The demo also uses Imaged Based Lighting to light the scenes.

projects.title: gba-rs
projects.description: Created a game boy advance emulator in rust for my Senior Design project. A web version compiled to WASM with a hand made debugger is available at https://gba-rs.github.io/web-frontend/
